infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: places2go uses your location to show restrooms near you, confirm you are at a place you submit, and measure distance.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: places2go uses the camera so you can add a photo of a restroom.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: places2go uses your photo library so you can add photos of a restroom.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: places2go uses the microphone for hands-free voice search.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: places2go uses speech recognition to understand hands-free voice search.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: places2go uses motion and compass data to point you toward a restroom.
